def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in g for x in row))
    separator = next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    color = g[separator][0]
    object_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(g[:separator]) if any(v not in (bg, color) for v in row)]
    top = min(object_rows)
    # Shift the object's occupied band down one cell; fill the vacated top row with 8.
    for r in range(separator - 1, top, -1):
        g[r] = g[r-1][:]
    g[top] = [8] * len(g[0])
    return g
PY
